mapper.delete: delete from WFL_ETR_ENTRUST where ENTRUST_ID = #{entrustId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
delete from WFL_ETR_ENTRUST_ADD where ENTRUST_ID = #{entrustId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
mapper.select: SELECT T1.FINPROD_MARKET_ID id, T1.FINPROD_ABBR text, T1.FINPROD_NAME, T1.FINPROD_ID, T1.CALENDAR_ID, T1.TRADE_MARKET, T1.IS_RIGHT, T2.TYPE_9, T2.TYPE_10, T2.TYPE_11, to_char(T1.VDATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') VDATE, to_char(T1.MDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') MDATE, T1.CCY FROM FIN_PRODUCT T1 LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE T2 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T2.FINPROD_ID
select 100-sum(nvl(PRIN_AMT,0)) from FIN_CASH_PLAN where FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} and MDATE <= to_date(#{sysdate},'yyyy-mm-dd') group by FINPROD_ID
SELECT CLOSE_PRICE FROM (SELECT * FROM MST_BOND_MARK_INFO_FULL WHERE SEC_ID = #{finprodMarketId} AND VALUE_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{sysdate},'yyyy-mm-dd') ORDER BY VALUE_DATE DESC) WHERE ROWNUM =1

SELECT EXERCISE_PRICE FROM FIN_EXERCISE_PLAN WHERE EXERCISE_DATE = ( SELECT MIN(EXERCISE_DATE) FROM FIN_EXERCISE_PLAN WHERE FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} AND EXERCISE_DATE >= TO_DATE(#{sysdate},'yyyy-mm-dd') ) AND FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} AND EXERCISE_TYPE = '02' AND EXERCISE_TYPE = '01'} and rownum = 1

SELECT V.SEC_ACCT_ID AS SECACCTID FROM PTL_SEC_ACCT PSA, STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO V LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT R ON R.REGIST_ORG = V.REGIST_ORG and V.TRADE_PLACE = R.trade_market WHERE PSA.ACCT_NO = V.SEC_ACCT_ID AND V.SEC_ACCT_TYPE = 'SEC' AND PSA.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId} AND R.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId}
SELECT P.ACCT_NO CASHACCTID FROM PTL_CAPACCT_INFO P LEFT JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO S ON P.ACCT_NO = S.ACCT_NO where P.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId} AND P.ACCT_TYPE = #{acctType} and rownum=1
